g.text: C5 R0 · 19 OCT 2026 · MILLIMETRES UNLESS MARKED · PRELIMINARY — NOT FOR FABRICATION
Solid: full-load position. Blue dashed box outlines: 35 mm jounce and 60 mm captured drop.
Supplier curves and force law held
Counterflush guide and cover screws, drilled clevises, pin washers/nuts, coil
centering pilots, tube cores and positive drop keepers are modeled. All final
fits, locking, spring fatigue and damper selection remain qualification items.
The prismatic journal box follows the frame. The main spherical bearing admits
axle inclination; seals, axial float and combined wheelset tilt still require
Coil free lengths use 1400 kg unsprung development allowance per truck; they are custom geometry proposals, not rated catalogue springs.
Working rebound retains compression. At 60 mm abnormal capture the coil can be loose; core and washer retain it, and no tensile spring force is credited.
Spring end-form and viewer tessellation are simplified; material, winding, grinding, heat treatment and load/fatigue tests require qualification.
Damper cylinder/rod/eyes are a physical procurement envelope with 5 mm nominal stop reserve; valving and a commercial part are not selected.
